completion:
Record the date, time, and vehicle information.
3. Note the test results, including any specific failures.
4. Include details on any observed anomalies or irregularities.
5. Add comments regarding the potential impact of the failed tests.
6. Finalize the report with your signature and date.

### What are the key components of a vehicle inspection report?

A vehicle inspection report should include the following key components:

  • Vehicle information: Make, model, year, VIN, and mileage
  • Inspection date and time
  • Inspector's name and credentials
  • Detailed findings from each system checked (brakes, tires, engine, etc.)
  • Recommendations for repairs or maintenance
  • Signature of the inspector and the date of completion

### How often should vehicle inspections be conducted?

Vehicle inspections should be conducted:

  • Annually for personal vehicles
  • As per local regulations, which
